_doc: Shared mini-game framework (omasterq.exe 1.05H). Coordinates: W,H = screen size (640x480|800x600|1024x768); OX=(W-640)/2, OY=(H-480)/2. Sprites drawn at anchor (x,y) using frame hx/hy (assets/sprites/*.json).

fps.src: FUN_0041dfe0 calls FUN_004238c0(0x28); FUN_004238c0 sets tickMs=1000/fps
fps.restore: on exit (result scene FUN_00419380) FUN_004238c0(DAT_00448150) restores board game speed; scene stack also saves/restores tickMs (FUN_004238d0 / pop in FUN_00419040)

easeStep.formula: step(cur,target,div) = (target-cur)/div (integer, toward 0), but at least ±1 when cur!=target

launcher.param: p<100 → standalone (from 小遊戲 menu), game index = p; p>=100 → from board tile, game index = p-100
launcher.boardTrigger: tile type 5 (minigame_icon 小遊戲) in FUN_00416ff0 case 5: FUN_0040edf0(); player+0x48=1; push scene 0x4433d0 with rand()%4+100

introComic.panels: center = game{i+1}, left (x-0x267) = game{((i+1)&3)+1}, right (x+0xee) = game{((i+2)&3)+1}; each 370x278 drawn top-left at (stripX+dx, stripY-0x8c) where dx ∈ {-0x267,-0xbe,+0xee}; film-strip overlay turn/bg frame0 drawn at (stripX, stripY) on top
introComic.motion: stripY=H/2; stripX starts at W + turnBg.w/2 (=W+772) and eases to W/2 with div 8; then all three panels advance frame 0..5 every 31 ticks (counter >30); after last frame the game scene replaces this one
introComic.sound: frame.wav once on enter (vol 255, pan centre)
introComic.background: screen snapshot captured at enter (FUN_00423f30) drawn first

zoomIn.desc: each game starts by growing a centred window from 370x278 (the comic panel size) to W×H; width/height each ease with div 4; the game's draw list is rendered into an off-screen surface and blitted scaled into the window over the launch snapshot; finishes when both steps <2

playfieldClip.note: games draw inside a 640x480-high band; MG02/03/04 backgrounds are repeated at x±640 when W>640

readyPhase.desc: every participating player shows dat\MiniGame\pressbutton.spr (frame1 base + frame0 'PRESS' button bobbing: offset += dir, dir flips at <-10 and >2, i.e. range -10..2 px per tick). Humans must RELEASE (key-up event) button 0 or 1 of their own device; AI is ready immediately. Ready players set bit (1<<slot) in a mask; when mask == all participants the READY/GO banner starts. Ready-ack sound drip.wav (vol 0x80).

kinds.0: ready.spr (4 frames: 0 left half, 1 right half, 2 'READY', 3 'GO')

sequence: enter: zoomin.wav (vol 200); half A (frame1) x from -frame0.w/2, half B (frame0) x from W+frame1.w/2, both y=H/2; text frame2 at (W/2,H/2) alpha 0
each tick: both halves ease to W/2 (div 4); text alpha += 16 (max 255)
then shrink: frames 1,0,2 drawn at (W/2,H/2) scaled s/32, s from 32 down to 1 (-1/tick)
if sprite has >3 frames (READY): GO (frame3) grows s from 1 by +3/tick to 32, then hold 40 ticks
done flag set → game removes banner

timer.display: number.fnt '%02d' of 30 - t/40 at (W/2 - textW/2 + 0x112, H/2 - 0xd9); bar from x0=W/2-0xfd, width t*0x1e7/0x4b0 (0..487 px), rows: y=H/2-0xc3 colour RGB(0x9a,0xff,0x99); y=H/2-0xc2..-0xaf colour RGB(3,0xe4,0); y=H/2-0xae colour RGB(1,0x5b,0); right edge vertical line in dark green
timer.timerFrame: bg frame (640x72) at (W/2,H/2) with hy=238 → top band

eligibility.rule: player slot participates unless player+0x34 status ∈ {-1 eliminated, 1 hospital, 2 jail, 5 (set by 0x416f30/0x416f60, meaning PARTIAL)}

layoutByCount.rule: MG02/03/04 recompute x of the k-th participant (k=0..n-1): x = W/(2n) + k*(W/n) when n<4; for n==4 the init value x = (W/4)*slot + W/8 is kept (same formula)
